description: The flows this week's work touched, on a fresh scratch database: first-run sign-up with the ZIP and RDO pickers, every screen, the birth date, 2551Q money boxes (a zero box, a filled one, Item 16 with Amended Yes and No), a schedule row deleted, Queue in the dry-run test build, Log out. Run with `just e2e <target> smoke --allow-send` under EBIR_TEST_ENV=1 BIR_SFTP_DRY_RUN=1; see docs/proof/E2E.md.

known_gap.phone: gap 1: the ZIP and RDO pickers are sheets on a phone, and gpui-agent presses inside sheets did not land in this week's rounds
gap 1: the date is set in a date sheet

recipes.name: money-boxes
recipes.needs_host: an app built with nsh-gpui-agent at hexuria/nsh-gpui-agent#11 (the software keyboard in the tree)

known_gap.macos: gap 2: under the old in-process macOS listener the money box refused agent text; this branch moves macOS to the strict adapter, not yet proven on a Mac

known_gap.phone: gap 1: the row drawer is a sheet on a phone

recipes.precondition: Queue validates first: a 2551Q holding only Items 15 and 16 may stop at its to-do list instead of the confirm dialog
